newsitem.title: USA: Nestle launches clinical nutrition unit.
newsitem.headline: Nestle launches clinical nutrition unit.

text.p: Nestle SA, the Swiss food company, said Monday it launched its newest business unit, Nestle Clinical Nutrition, based here.
The unit will focus on providing enteral nutrition products for institutions such as hospitals and nursing homes, and for home care applications.

Enteral formulas provide a supplemental source of nutrition for patients recovering from illness, and also provide total nourishment for those who cannot meet their nutritional needs, such as the elderly or patients with chronic disease.
Nestle said its Nestle Clinical Nutrition unit evolved from Clintec Nutrition Co, a 10-year joint venture with Baxter International Inc, which is coming to a close, as previously announced.

"Backed by Nestle's commitment to research and development, we will continue to develop innovative nutritional products and therapies which effectively improve the quality of patient care," Gerard Carino, president of Nestle Clinical Nutrition for North America, said in a statement.
